task.description:
Rework tests to resolve 03b FAIL findings:

1. Integration tests must FAIL clearly (not skip) when BPM_TEST_DB_URL is missing for MUST TM tests.
2. Replace static TM-04/TM-05 integration slugs with per-test UUID-based fixture identifiers.
3. Remove hardcoded fallback credentials from web/tests/e2e/tenants.e2e.spec.ts and enforce env-driven credentials in line with test directives.

After fixes, keep TM-04/TM-05 coverage intact and update specs if needed.
acceptance_criteria: No env-missing skip path on MUST TM integration tests
Per-test UUID fixture IDs used in TM-04/TM-05 integration tests
No hardcoded fallback credentials in tenants e2e test

result.summary: Reworked TM-04/TM-05 tests to clear 03b findings: env-missing now fails clearly in integration tests, lifecycle fixtures use UUID-based slugs per test, and tenants E2E credentials are strictly env-driven with no hardcoded fallback.
